description: Probe-only rejection library for HIP_FLASH2_ENGINE (Flash-Attention 2 forward, hip_flash2_engine): a legal half (fp16) SDPA forward (head size 64 or 128 for Q, K, V and O, BSHD or BHSD, grouped-query heads, seqlen_q a multiple of 64, seqlen_kv >= 94 so that it clears the shape crossover, no mask, declared alignment 16) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis; every family is a graph the frontend accepts. `expect` is `declined` where the engine must not take the graph (the kernel has no input for the feature or a stated unsupported configuration, so an accept computes something else) and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it (then it must be right). Lines cited are in dnn-providers/hip-kernel-provider/src/engines/hip_flash2_engine/HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder.cpp, isApplicable (lines 72-251), unless noted. ARCH: the engine dispatches on gfx942 only; on gfx950 (the only device available) EVERY case is declined at the device gate (line 90), so this space is written and checked in pytest only (space load, expansion and structure checks), and is not run on a device; the expectations below are the gfx942 ones. none: control, a plain graph the engine takes on gfx942. odd_sq: seqlen_q not a multiple of 64 (K3 gate, line 219-221: a partial query tile would diverge at __syncthreads) with skv 1024; a limitation a correct engine may lift: declined_or_pass. odd_skv: seqlen_kv odd or not divisible by 4 or 32 (95, 99, 127, 129, 255, 257; at least 94, so the crossover of useFlash2ForShape, HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder.hpp:83-92, is cleared); the engine has no gate on it and a correct engine may serve it: declined_or_pass. odd_head_size: head size 8, 63, 96, 126, 129, 256, not divisible by 4 or not 64/128 (line 199-201): declined_or_pass. odd_heads: odd or unshipped head counts such as (1, 1), (5, 1), (6, 2), (7, 7), (9, 3), (15, 5) (only Hq % Hkv is gated, line 209): declined_or_pass. kv_heads_differ: V has a different head count than K (both divide Hq, which the frontend allows). The engine checks only Hq % Hkv (line 207-212) and extractParams (line 450-456) reads the head count of K for V as well: KNOWN GAP, expect `declined` (it shows as a violation or WRONG). v_head_size: V and O head size differ from Q and K; line 203-204 requires head_dim_v == head_dim_qk: `declined`. dt_q_other, dt_k_other, dt_v_other, dt_o_other: one of Q, K, V, O in bf16 while the rest is fp16; line 187-195 requires all four HALF, and an accepted graph would read or write the buffer as the wrong type: `declined`. dt_o_float: float O with fp16 inputs, same line 195: `declined`. dt_all_bf16 and dt_all_float: all four in bf16 or fp32; line 195 (no such kernel is built) but a correct engine may add one: declined_or_pass. dropout_philox (dropout_probability 0.1 with seed and offset, line 110) and rng_dump (the same plus an rng_dump output, line 110): `declined`. dropout_zero: dropout_probability 0.0 alone; line 110 declines only a value != 0, and no dropout is a valid graph: declined_or_pass. dropout_mask: explicit dropout mask and scale tensors without dropout_probability; isApplicable never looks at dropout_mask or dropout_scale, so the engine would ignore them: KNOWN GAP, expect `declined`. attn_mask (line 115), alibi (alibi_mask, line 113), padding (padding_mask with both seq_len tensors, lines 114 and 121), seq_len_q and seq_len_kv (one tensor each, line 121-123), paged_kv (page tables and max_seq_len_kv with a single 64-row block so K and V keep a dense shape; page tables line 116-117, and it needs seq_len tensors so line 121 declines too), sink (line 118), stats (stats tensor with generate_stats, line 119-120) and row_stats (stats, max, sum_exp with generate_stats, line 119): `declined`. stats_no_flag: a stats tensor with generate_stats unset; line 119 reads generate_stats only, so the engine accepts the graph and the stats output is never written: KNOWN GAP, expect `declined`. max_sum_exp: max and sum_exp output tensors with generate_stats unset, never looked at: KNOWN GAP. block_mask (block-sparse mask tensor), scale_tensor (device-resident scale tensor), scale_tensor_value (pass-by-value scale tensor), descale_qkv (descale_q/k/v) and fp8_softmax_scales (descale_s, scale_s, scale_o, amax_s, amax_o): isApplicable never looks at these uids, and attnScaleFor (HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder_v2.hpp:30) reads attn_scale_value only (1.0 when unset, so a scale tensor is ignored): KNOWN GAPS, expect `declined`. bottom_right: bottom-right causal with seqlen_q != seqlen_kv; only NO_MASK and TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL are served (line 181-184), and the top-left kernel would compute another mask: `declined`. sliding_window: left_bound 32 with right_bound 0 (line 181-184): the kernel has no window but a correct engine may add one: declined_or_pass. overflow_dims and overflow_strides: `ovf` pairs one case for each family (overflow_dims takes the first of the pair, overflow_strides the second), run at enforcement_level buildable (no tensor is allocated, filled or executed). overflow_dims: batch_dim (B = 2**31), batch_u32 (B = 2**32, which narrows to 0), hq_dim, sq_dim, hd_dim (dimFitsI32 on every dim, line 142-154) and skv_ceiling (Skv = INT32_MAX - 63, one above K_FLASH2_MAX_SEQ_LEN_KV = INT32_MAX - 64, line 158, HipFlash2FwdPlanBuilder.hpp:106-107): `declined`. overflow_strides (q_batch, k_batch, k_head, v_row, o_row: a stride element of 2**31 on Q's batch, K's batch, K's head, V's row or O's row axis; o_batch_2p32: 2**32 on O's batch; all on a stepped axis with B = Hq = Hkv = 2, Sq = 64, Skv = 128, head size 64): extractParams narrows Q, K, V and O strides to int (line 468-479, kernel args are int, HipFlash2KernelUtils.hpp:148-159) and isApplicable has no stride range gate: KNOWN GAP, expect `declined` (the engine truncates the stride and the kernel addresses the wrong memory). An accepted and built overflow case is reported `UNEXERCISED` with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`. The space is probe-only and never frozen into a bundle.

derive.hq: ovr[2] if ov else (odd[3][0] if oh else shape[2])
derive.hkv_e: ovr[3] if ov else (odd[3][1] if oh else shape[3])
derive.sq_e: ovr[4] if ov else (odd[0] if family == 'odd_sq' else shape[4])
derive.skv_e: ovr[5] if ov else (odd[1] if family == 'odd_skv' else (64 if family == 'paged_kv' else (1024 if family == 'odd_sq' else shape[5])))
derive.dqk: ovr[6] if ov else (odd[2] if family == 'odd_head_size' else shape[6])
derive.dv: (64 if dqk == 128 else 128) if family == 'v_head_size' else dqk
derive.hv: (1 if hkv_e == hq else hq) if family == 'kv_heads_differ' else hkv_e
derive.bq0: (sq_e * hq * dqk) if layout == 'bshd' else (hq * sq_e * dqk)
derive.bk0: (skv_e * hkv_e * dqk) if layout == 'bshd' else (hkv_e * skv_e * dqk)
derive.bv0: (skv_e * hv * dv) if layout == 'bshd' else (hv * skv_e * dv)
derive.bo0: (sq_e * hq * dv) if layout == 'bshd' else (hq * sq_e * dv)
derive.stride_q: [(so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'q' and ovr[8] == 0) else bq0), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'q' and ovr[8] == 1) else bq1), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'q' and ovr[8] == 2) else bq2), 1]
derive.stride_k: [(so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'k' and ovr[8] == 0) else bk0), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'k' and ovr[8] == 1) else bk1), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'k' and ovr[8] == 2) else bk2), 1]
derive.stride_v: [(so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'v' and ovr[8] == 0) else bv0), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'v' and ovr[8] == 1) else bv1), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'v' and ovr[8] == 2) else bv2), 1]
derive.stride_o: [(so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'o' and ovr[8] == 0) else bo0), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'o' and ovr[8] == 1) else bo1), (so_v if (ov_str and ovr[7] == 'o' and ovr[8] == 2) else bo2), 1]
derive.dtq: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else ('bfloat16' if family in ['dt_all_bf16', 'dt_q_other'] else 'half')
derive.dtk: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else ('bfloat16' if family in ['dt_all_bf16', 'dt_k_other'] else 'half')
derive.dtv: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else ('bfloat16' if family in ['dt_all_bf16', 'dt_v_other'] else 'half')
derive.dto: 'float' if family in ['dt_all_float', 'dt_o_float'] else ('bfloat16' if family in ['dt_all_bf16', 'dt_o_other'] else 'half')
